notes: fieldWeatherId aligns 1:1 with main src/lib/fieldWeather.ts WEATHER_TABLE (PR #64, merged; Black 2 table order 0-14, generic keys). fieldWeather.ts owns the state machine; this file owns per-place selection, particle caps, lightning switching, and presentation fade limits.

Mist and smog have no exact entry in the #64 table: they use the closest tint/fog entry and say so (fieldWeatherNote), with a presentation-only particle kind. Nothing here pretends the table contains them.

FireRed/Emerald note: neither game has time-of-day lighting, so no FireRed/Emerald weather-lighting values exist in this file. Time tables come from the HeartGold/Crystal structure only (see timeOfDay.ts).

globalRules.particleCapNote: Every variant's particleCount is <= 200. The Pixi pool (pixiLayers.createParticlePool) enforces the same cap in code.

lightning.offSwitch: settings.weather.lightning (to be added by the settings lane; until it exists, lightningFlash() takes lightningEnabled as an argument and refuses to flash when false)
lightning.offSwitchNote: When the switch is off, thunderstorm shows rain + dark tint only — never a flash. Photosensitivity safety is a refusal in code, not a UI promise.

timeFade.note: PR #64 source fade frames are preserved in each variant's sourceFadeFrames; the presentation layer clamps crossfades to 60-120 frames. Sunny's source 160 frames (2.67 s) is therefore clamped, not silently rewritten.

winter.note: Winter tint does not replace the snow-cover secondary tileset; both may apply.

dateGatedSparkle.note: HeartGold date-gated sparkle weather (main src/lib/fieldWeather.ts DATE_GATED_SPARKLE_DATES, PR #64 merged): on these 8 month/day pairs a summit-type map may use 'specks' instead of its map weather. All 8 verified against main.

neon-rain.label: Neon rain
neon-rain.fieldWeatherNote: Place weather 'neon_rain' from main WEATHER_CONFIG (violet fog + rain particles); #64 id 2 is its rain engine.

jungle-leaves.label: Jungle leaves
jungle-leaves.fieldWeatherNote: Place weather 'jungle' from main WEATHER_CONFIG (green fog + leaves); #64 id 5 is its flutter engine.

mist.label: Mist
mist.fieldWeatherNote: No exact mist entry in the #64 table: tintFixed (id 9) carries the fog; 'mist' particles are presentation-only fog drift, count 0 in the pool.

smog.label: Smog
smog.fieldWeatherNote: Place weather 'smog' from main WEATHER_CONFIG (brown fog + smog drift); #64 tint entry carries the fog, smog drift is presentation-only.
